title: Logo Color Usage / Outdoor sequence
slide_intent: Compare a color family at environmental scale because a permitted swatch pair must also work in a viewer’s surroundings.
strategic_value: Repeated burger silhouettes can connect varied Burger King colorways along a street frontage.
demonstration: Six adjacent outdoor panels repeat the logo at a common scale across pale, red, brown and orange fields.
practical_value: Assess how repeated scale and shape connect varied color treatments in an outdoor sequence.

content_islands.name: Logo panel sequence
content_islands.spec: Run six equal-height panels across the lower central field, retaining each logo/background combination.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Keep the buildings above and pavement below so the sequence reads as environmental marketing.

reference_purposes.Expression: Six coordinated colorways keep the same burger silhouette and letterforms.
reference_purposes.Application: The color combinations are presented on an outdoor panel installation.
